```yaml
name: Java Bulk CDK Base Publish

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install Pants
        uses: pantsbuild/actions/init-pants@v10
        with:
          get-pants-version: '1.20.0'
          cache-lmdb-store: true

      - name: Detect changed connectors
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v46
        id: changed
        with:
          separator: ','
          files: 'airbyte-integrations/connectors/**/metadata.yaml'

      - name: Log in to GHCR
        if: steps.changed.outputs.all_changed_and_modified_files != ''
        run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" | docker login ghcr.io -u ${{ github.actor }} --password-stdin

      - name: Build and push connectors
        if: steps.changed.outputs.all_changed_and_modified_files != ''
        run: |
          echo "Changed connectors: ${{ steps.changed.outputs.all_changed_and_modified_files }}"
          for file in ${{ steps.changed.outputs.all_changed_and_modified_files }}; do
            connector_dir=$(dirname "$file")
            image_name="ghcr.io/airbytehq/$(basename "$connector_dir")"
            echo "Building $image_name"
            docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 \
              -t "$image_name:latest" \
              -t "$image_name:${{ github.sha }}" \
              --push \
              "$connector_dir"
          done
        env:
          DOCKER_BUILDKIT: 1
          DOCKER_CLI_EXPERIMENTAL: enabled
```
